༄༅/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs dang slob ma rjes 'dzin bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs dang

slob ma rjes 'dzin bzhugs/ na mo badz+ra bhe rā wa ya/ gang zhig ye shes 'bar ba'i me lce yis/ /ma lus bdud sde'i tshang tshing kun bsregs nas/ /bden gnyis snang byed ye shes 'od brgya 'gyed/ /rdo rje slob dpon dpa' bo che la 'dud/ /bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs 'dir zhugs na/ /drag shul spyod pa mtha' dag ni/ / skad cig gcig gis 'grub 'gyur zhes/ /dus gzhan zhig na bla ma gsung*/ 'dir sgyu grwa 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud las kyang gsungs shing*/ dpal kha sbyor thig le las gsal bar bstan pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i gzhung gi don/ mchog tu bsdus pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sgrub thabs sgom par 'dod pas/ dur khrod la sogs pa dben pa'i gnas su skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams sngon du btang zhing*/ rang skad cig gi 'jig mdzad du gsal ba'i snying khar pad nyi la gnas pa'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dza/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mo badz+ra bhe ra wa maṇ+ḍal bh+ya/ badz+ra lā s+ya/ sogs kyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs bdun rnam dag bya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig las grub pa'i bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su chos kyi 'byung gnas chen po mi zad cing 'jigs pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi yongs su bskor ba'i nang du thod rus 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang yangs shing rgya che la dpangs mtho ba de'i dbus su/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam dud kha la gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i dhiḥlas rang nyid 'jam dpal zhi bar 'gyur ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rig mar bcas pa thams cad du gdul dka' 'dul ba'i rnam pa can du spyan drangs te rang la thim/

rang nyid kyang thugs ka'i nyi ma la thim/ de nyid 'bar ba dang bcas shing dpag tshad brgyad stong gi tshad du gyur/ de'i 'gyur ba las/ hūṃ dang rdo rje 'bar ba chen po'o/ /yang 'od zer spro bsdus mkha' dbyings gang ba'i 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i tshogs rnams bdag nyid la 'dus pa las/ rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i skur gyur/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tiḥwi kri tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jig byed sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar rab tu gnag pa/ zhal bzhi phyag brgyad zhabs bzhi pa/ sku sbom zhing thung la gsus khyim che ba gcer bu ling ga gyen du bsgreng ba/ sdang ba dang gdug pa can thams cad kyi sha dang rkang dang tshil za ba ha hā dang hūṃ hūṃ dang pheṃ kyi sgra gnam du 'bod pa/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha thams cad la sdigs mdzub byed pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal mthing nag ma he khros pa'i gdong*/ rdo rje'i rwa gdeng bas phyogs thams cad gnon pa/ g.yas zhal dkar po rgya cher bzhad cing*/ g.yon zhal dmar po rab tu 'jigs pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ dbu'i gtsug tu 'jam dpal gyi zhal gser mdog yid tsam khro ba/ zur phud lnga dang ldan pa'o/ khro zhal thams cad dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra kham ser me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyi rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gtun shing dang*/ ral gri dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ cang te'u rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭaṃ ga dang*/ thod khrag dang*/ mda' gzhu dang*/ zhags pa bsnams pa ste/ ral gri dang thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ dang po gnyis kyi glang po che'i lpags pa yang brgyangs te bsnams pa'o/ /zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang zhing*/ rgyab ma gnyis gar gyi tshul gyis mnan pa/ sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug dang klu chen po brgyad kyis dkris pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/

khrag 'dzag mgo bo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku las sprul pa'i rdo rje pho nya'i tshogs kyis nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'geng ba/ 'jigs dus kyi me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ srid pa gsum gyi blta bar yang mi bzod pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ mig tu k+ṣaṃ/ rna bar dz+raṃ/ sna la khaṃ/ lce la gaṃ /dpral bar skaṃ/ lte bar saṃ/ spyi bor aṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥ dmar po/ snying khar hūṃ sngon po sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs te gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum la thim/ rang gi snying gar ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal zhi ba/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma la hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dbang gi lha dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mchod yon nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ sarba tā tha ga ta/ zhes sol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ su ra ta s+t+woṃ ā haṃ/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur te mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes de thams cad rang la gnyis su med par thim/ gshin rje gshed kyi dam rgya bcas gnas gsum du gtugs la/ rtsa sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ nye snying rnams brjod do/ /de nas sgeg sogs brgyad kyis mchod pa dang*/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ / sogs dang*/ dur khrod rgyan gyi/ sogs kyi mchod cing bstod/ bdud rtsi myang ba 'jigs byed sgrub thabs rwa lugs spyi dang 'dra/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa yang 'dra ste/ rtsa sngags yi ge so gnyis dang*/ snying po bcu pa dang*/ nye snying bdun pa rnams spyi dang 'dra ba dang*/ hrīḥṣ+tiḥ yi ge bcu bzhi pa khyad par du bzla'o/ /mthar snying kha'i 'od zer gyi snod bcud dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gyur pa/ gzhal yas khang la thim/ de rang nyid la thim/ rang ye she sems dpa' la thim/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la/

de yang stong pa nyid du sbyang ngo*/ /stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ srung ba'i don du skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis rlabs so/ /dge ba bsngo/ 'di la srung 'khor mi bsdu ba man ngag yin no/ / gtor ma 'bum tshul ni/ byin rlabs sogs thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs rgyas pa dang 'dra ba las/ 'bul ba'i sngags ni/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar mahā badz+ra bhai ra wa mahā a dhi pa ti i daṃ ba ling kha kha khā hi khā hi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyi 'bul ba ni khyad par ro/ /tshul 'dis snying po 'bum phrag bcu bzla ba ni bsnyen pa'o/ /yang gzhan yang sngar dang 'dra ba las/ dbang bskur rgyas btab kyi rjes su/ rang gi ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i 'khor bzhi skad cig gi grub pa ni/ mdun du raṃ las rdo rje srin po smug nag ral gri dang thod pa 'dzin pa khyi'i gdong pa can/ g.yas su ya las las kyi gshin rje sngo skya be con thogs pa/ g.yon du ma las dus mtshan ma dmar mo rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu hūṃ las dpal mgon nag po gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang ral pa mun ltar gtib pa/ stag lpags kyis smad dkris dang*/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs gsol ba/ sbrul rgyan dang mi mgo'i 'phreng ba can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyi mi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ / zhes bskyed nas mchod bstod yan chad sngar bzhin bya/ gtso bo'i bzlas pa song rjes su 'khor bzhi po la gtso bo'i bzhi cha re bzla ste/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sa bha k+ṣa sa sha truṃ i ti phaṭa/ rdo rje'i srin po'o/ / oṃ ka la rū pa hūṃ phaṭa/ las kyi gshin rje'o/ / bh+yo kā la tri bh+yoḥ dus mtshan ma'o/ / oṃ mahā kā la ru pa sha hūṃ phaṭa/ nag po chen po'o/ /gtor 'bul gyi skabs 'khor bzhi yang spyan drangs nas/ so so'i snying po'i mthar/

ā ka ro btags pas 'bul/ nag po chen po la sha sa nas kyang lhag por 'bul ba yin no/ /'khor gyi bstod pa bsdus pa ni/ dbang phyug chen po'i dkyil 'khor gnas mchog tu/ /dbang med dang pas 'dus pa dang*/ /ye shes sprul pa'i lha tshogs la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod par bgyi/ / zhes pa tsam gyis chog ste nye ba'i bsnyen pa'o/ /sgom don dang mthun par dkyil 'khor bris la/ dam rdzas mchod gtor tshogs pa byas nas/ bdag mdun tha mi dad pa'i tshul gyis zla ba drug la sogs par gtso 'khor gyi sngags sbrel nas bzlas sgom byed pa ni sgrub pa'o/ /'khor gyi sngags bsdu na/ raṃ yaṃ bh+yo hūm̐/ zhes pa tsam gyi chog go /de nyid dang 'dra ba las thun mtshams kyi skabs ma gtogs/ bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgom bzlas byed pa ste/ zla ba phyed nas zla ba drug gi bar byed pa ni/ sgrub pa chen po'o/ / de nas ni las la sbyar bas ji ltar bde bar 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /'di la sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang*/ kha sbyor las 'khor rdo rje srin po gcig pu las gsungs kyang*/ gzhan rnams bla ma'i man ngag las 'byung la/ 'di'i rtogs pa bsdus pa las kyang don gyi ma bshad do/ /yang mdun du rdo rje srin po gshin rje/ dus mtshan gsum gsum sbrags su chad pa'i lugs kyang yod de/ 'dam kha yin pa'i phyir ji ltar bde bar bya'o/ / sgrub thabs 'di'i dbang chog gam/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga ni/ stegs bu yangs pa la chos 'byung gru gsum mthing kha me ris bskor/ phyi zlum skor yang rdo rwa dang me ris skor/ gru chad dmar po bya'o/ /dbus nyi gdan la tshom bu nag po lnga bkod/ de'i steng du mañdzi la/ thod pa shas gang ba'i dkyil du/ 'khrul 'khor dang ral gri btsugs/ bdud rtsi lngas kyang sbags/ phyogs bzhir stegs bur dmar gtor re yang bkod/ mdun du 'bul gtor gnyis/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ khrag gi ar+ghaṃ sha chen gyi bdug spos/

sha rus kyi zhal zas rnams kyang khyad par du bsham/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ gong bzhin bdag bskyed sgom/ bzlas pa cung zad bya/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig las/ zhes pa nas/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i nang du/ de'i dbus su thod rus 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang*/ zhes pa nas/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ de'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i skur gyur/ ces pa nas/ mi bzod pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ mdun du ram las= sogs 'khor bzhi bskyed/ mig tu k+ṣiṃ nas mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar yang bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las/ 'khor rnams la rigs bdag gtso bo phyag gnyis pas dbu brgyan pa'am/ gtso 'khor thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ ces pa dang*/ bdag mdun gyi 'don pa spo tshul shes dgos so/ /bar 'dir bzlas pa cung zad bya/ de nas gtor ma 'bul te/ gtor ma dang po lha lnga la 'bul/ gnyis pa phyogs skyong bcu la 'bul/ thun mong du slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis rlob par gsol ba btab/ gang yang rung ba'i bum pa dri bzang gi chus bkang nas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya ba'i sngags kyi yig 'bru rab tu 'bar ba'i rang bzhin du bsam/ sngags de nyid brgya stong dang*/ a bhi ṣe ka ta nyer gcig bzlas/ 'di slob ma rnams dang por khrus bya ba'i bum pa de yin no/ /yang stegs bu gzhan zhig gi steng du dbang bskur ba'i bum pa 'cha' ste/ de yang thod pa'am/ rin po che'i bum pa yang rung la/ shing gi snod du bya ba min gsung*/ des na phal cher lag la rdza'i bum pa zhig khrag dang chang sres pa'i spos chus bkang*/ nag por byug kha rgyan mi dgos/ thod pa chang gis bkang bas kha bcad/ de'i dbus su lha lnga po skad cig gis gsal btab nas sngags brgya brgya tsam bzla'o/

/kā pa la'i myos byed so so'i sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas phul/ rdo rje'i 'phreng ba zhig la gtso bo'i sngags lan brgya bzla zhing*/ hūṃ las byung ba rgyal ba mi bskyod pa'i bdag nyid du mos/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dh+rika hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa'ang brgya brgyad bzla'o/ / de nas slob ma rnams la bgegs sbyang ba dang*/ sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ khrus rnams sngon du song nas sems bskyed gsal btab/ chos bshad bya/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ dga' chen khyod bdag / sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ / sogs kyis dam la bzhag /dkyil chog las 'byung ba ltar ye shes dbab pa bya/ lha ngo bstan/ e ma ho sangs rgyas slob dpon che/ /e ma ho chos dang tshogs kyi mchog /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ / ces lan gsum/ de nas slob ma gtso bo bskyed/ snying khar yang gtso bo dang*/ lte bar 'khor bzhi sgom/ re re bzhin bzlas lung phog re re bzhin sngags bzlas pa'i bum pa'i chu'i dbang lan lnga bskur dgos te/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /sogs kyi mthar so so'i sngags kyi mjug la/ a bhi ṣiñtsa/ btags pas so/ /de rjes gtso bo'i dam rdzas dang*/ 'khor rnams kyi gtor dbang yang rim bzhin du bya/ rdo rje 'phreng ba la me tog sna tshogs bcings te/ slob ma'i mgo bor dbang bskur te/ u dum wa ra man+ta ra/ / zhes sogs brjod/ thod pa'i dbus kyi ral gri lag tu gtad la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ral gri che= sogs/ rdor dril gtad la/ shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin bdag / sogs/ bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod sbyin la/ btung ba rin chen/ sogs brjod/ gshin rje gshed kyi drag po'i 'khor lo lag tu gtad la/ bsgral bar bya ba'i yul lnga ni/ /'khor lo dang ni ting nge 'dzin/ /sngags sam sman gyi gsad bya ste/ /yang na gnas las spos par bya*/

/ zhes dang rtsa sngags la/ abhi'i ṣiñtsa btags pa brjod do/ /slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ tshogs 'khor cho gas tshogs btang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi rjes kyi bya ba'ang gzhan gyi 'dre'o/ /kun la yongs su ma grags kyang*/ /rgyud don shes pa rnams dga' ba/ /mkhas pa'i snying la zhen pa ltar/ /gsal por bkod pa 'di nyid do/ /dngos grub kun gyi sgrub pa'i thabs /'jug sgo tsam zhig brjod pa las/ /dge ba cung zad gang bsags te/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed dpal thob shog /'di la rdo rje 'jigs byed rgyas pa sgrub thabs rwa lugs sngon du shes pa gal che la/ de nas 'di tsam kho nas 'grub ste/ mchog tu bsdus pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs slob ma'i rjes zung dang bcas pa gsal por bkod pa 'di yang*/ slob bu dam tshig can sngags 'chang dkon mchog legs 'dzin gyi bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas sbyar ba'o// //bkra shis// zhus dag /'di bris dge bas ma rgan sems can thams cad gshin rje dus dgra'i rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par rgyur gyur cig / mes po'i shul bzhag las/
tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 104 -- PAGE 103 -- PAGE 97 -
